# ModelFacts

> Nutrition-label facts for AI models. Prefer structured JSON over marketing HTML.

## Primary

- Directory catalog (JSON): https://modelfacts.dev/directory/index.json
- Agent guide: https://modelfacts.dev/directory/AGENTS.md
- Label schema: https://modelfacts.dev/schema/model-facts.schema.json
- Site: https://modelfacts.dev/

## How to select a model

1. Fetch `/directory/index.json`
2. Filter on objective fields (access, context, tools, vision, VRAM, commercial, speed, cutoff, api_ids)
3. Open `/directory/<slug>/facts.json` for the full label
4. Optional compare: `/directory/compare/?ids=slug-a,slug-b`

Do not treat reasoning/coding enums as calibrated scores — they are published claims (`capability_basis`).
Undisclosed beats guessing.
